uncovered_requests: No WP owns buff and debuff visuals on the player or on creatures (critic #7). NpcRenderer.cs:141-143 and PlayerAvatar.Gear.cs:77-80 draw nothing for On Fire!, Poisoned, Frostburn, Ichor, Cursed Inferno, Shadowflame, Confused or Well Fed. P2-14 only adds the icon bar. Absorb this in a new P3-47 [M], scheduled after P3-08 (EffectKit): add a `visual` block to BuffDef (tint, particle id, optional light), validated in ContentValidator.Projectiles.cs once P0-01 has split the validator. NPCs get an instance-shader tint and pooled EffectKit emitters; the player gets the same through PlayerAvatar.Gear. Scale by effectsScale. Smoke test in combat.cmds: `buff on_fire` then `assert fx.status_emitters >= 1`.

Movement feel has no owner and P3 lists it as out of scope (game-feel #16, critic #15). The jump reaches only about half of Terraria's height relative to the body, Hermes Boots give an instant +45%, and the Sprint key speeds up everyone. Absorb this in a new P3-46 [S], after P3-26. Changes: in data/config/movement.json, a jump apex of about 5-6 cells for the 3.6-cell body; a run-up acceleration curve for boots in MovementConfig; Sprint only with a run-speed bonus; PlayerController.Air.cs. Smoke test in movement.cmds using a new `player.jump_apex_cells` probe.

Chest lids never open (critic #16). Absorb this in a new P3-48 [S], after P1b-10 (TileObjectRenderer.Groups). In tools/blender/bgen/furniture.py, export the lid as a separate pivoted node. The renderer draws container lids as a second MultiMesh whose rotation follows the open state. P2-17 already plays chest_close.

Music and ambience gaps (game-feel #8, #17): no rain, town, underground-biome or night variants; no boss-defeat stinger; the Ambient bus is unused; fishing bites, hotbar switches and water entry are silent. Proposed split: (1) a new P3-49 [M] covering music tracks and variants (tools/audio/composer.py + MusicDirector rules), ambient loops on the Ambient bus, and the fishing-bite sound; (2) the hotbar tick in P2-12 (HotbarBar); (3) water entry in P3-26; (4) projectile impacts in P3-11; (5) the boss-defeat stinger in P4-03.

Euclidean (non-octahedral) light propagation was deferred by P1 and has no owner. Torch light falls off to about 4 m on diagonals against 7 m along the axes (LightEngine.cs:131), which is part of the 'tiny torch radius' complaint. Add an optional P1b-17 [M] at the end of W2 lane A, triggered if the player still finds torches small after P1-04. It uses a face/edge step-cost table (2/3) in the LightEngine BFS in Core, with LightEngine tests and a mesh-bench comparison. No GenVersion bump: light is not part of the golden ChunkHash.

Two art gaps are not covered (art #4, #10): themed enemies are recoloured humans with only 4 hat types, and fur, feathers and chitin all use the woven cloth texture. (1) Fold fur/scale/chitin/bone texture layers into P3-43 (tools/textures/props.json). (2) Add a new P3-50 [M] themed-humanoid kit in tools/blender/bgen/human/accessories.py: goblin ears and skin, pirate gear, skeleton casters, cultist robes.

Furniture and crafting stations are unbevelled boxes (art #12). The player wants realistic 3D world visuals, but P3 excludes this. Add a new P4-38 [M] in the W9 art lane: a bevel pass over tools/blender/bgen/furniture.py and mesh.py that reuses P4-17's dungeon_furniture helpers.

Pylons (section H) are in no WP. Add a new P5-34 [M] after P5-12 (happiness) and P5-29 (housing UI): biome pylon tile objects sold when two or more happy NPCs live nearby, teleport from WorldMapScreen, and Core PylonNetwork tests.
The Clothier Voodoo Doll (section I) is missing. Add the item and its drop (the Clothier killed while the player wears the Red Hat) to P4-20. Add its use (summons Skeletron at night) to P4-11.

No WP title owns the rarity colours for tiers 9-11 or the special tiers -11/-12/-13 (51-52 items wrong; UiTheme.cs:39-52 falls through to yellow at 8+). Add a Core test for SaveCatalog.

wrong_or_risky: The PlayerEntity move and the ItemUseSystem split are planned three times: P1-01, P2-25 and P3-01 all 'add' src/Strata.Core/Session/PlayerEntity.cs, and P1-01, P2-19 and P3-01 all add a consumable partial under two different names (Consumables.cs and Consume.cs). P1-10 and P3-01 are the same work package: both put useAnimation separate from useTime, both create a UseTiming.cs (Gameplay/Items vs Gameplay/Interaction) and both create UseTimingTests.cs. Keep P1-10. Reduce P3-01 to real gun bursts and reuseDelay, sized S.

P1-10 says 'speed bonuses scale useAnimation'. That is right for melee speed and speed prefixes, but in Terraria pickaxe or mining speed shortens only the tool's useTime; the tool hits several times inside one continuing swing. ItemUseSystem.cs:110 already divides useTime by MiningSpeed. UseTimingTests must assert that mining speed leaves UseAnimation unchanged and never restarts the clip.

P1-06 locks body yaw to camera yaw so the player strafes with A/D, but no strafe clips exist. HumanoidAnimator.States has only idle, walk, run, sprint and so on, and motion.py has only walk and run. Pure sideways movement would look like sliding. Fix: keep the pelvis and legs twisted up to 70 degrees toward the movement direction (the existing MaxTwist) while chest, head and arms follow the camera yaw exactly, and add strafe_left and strafe_right to P1-12's clip rebuild.

Npc.Volumes() (Npc.cs:132-142) is a `yield` iterator, so it allocates an enumerator on every call. P1-07's 'allocation-free' EntityPicking must not call it per NPC per frame. Add VolumeCount and VolumeAt(i) accessors to Npc, plus an allocation test using GC.GetAllocatedBytesForCurrentThread.

Boss parts and defeat flags: the BossPart docs (EnemyDef.cs) tell parts to carry the boss's Flag. NpcSystem.Kill only raises BossDefeated when GroupAlive is false (NpcSystem.cs:119-120,317). When a leader dies, followers are dropped through FollowLeader and Remove, not Kill. So if Skeletron's head dies while its flagged hands are still alive, the flag is never set and BossDefeated never fires. Hud.UpdateBossBar would also add the hands' life to the bar. P4-01 must add BossPart semantics: DiesWithBody (parts are excluded from GroupAlive and killed after the body) and InBossBar, which P2-23's BossBarModel reads. BossFrameworkTests must cover both.

P5-09 plans to change it to ICombatTarget only after P4 has written HandBrain, CryptWardenBrain, PlantBrains, PatternBrain.Moves and Illusions, and after WormBrain and MawwallBrain edits. Move the type change (PlayerEntity implements ICombatTarget, plus a TargetPlayer helper for player-only effects such as confusion and the tongue) into P4-01. P5-09 then only adds town residents as targets.

P1b-04 edits SurfaceNetsMesher.cs, which is at 371 lines. Keep all new logic in HeightfieldSmoothing.cs so the mesher grows by less than 25 lines. Because collisions are built from the surface-nets mesh (ChunkMesher.cs:66), the smoothing must keep the MaxDrift clamp (0.45 cells) so visuals and colliders still agree, and it must be seam-identical across chunk borders. Add Core tests for the drift bound and for a chunk meshed alone matching the same chunk meshed among its neighbours. Re-run movement.cmds (the P1-09 hook on natural terrain) and builder.cmds after it lands.

P2-11 lists only 8 files, but InputGate is read in 14: PlayerController.Grapple.cs, PlayerController.Air.cs and PlayerController.Ride.cs, WorldMapScreen.cs, DebugConsole.cs, PerfOverlay.cs and MenuKit.cs as well. Keep GameplayBlocked meaning 'modal open' so those files keep working, and add a separate OverlayOpen or PointerFree flag for the inventory. Smoke test in ui.cmds: `ui inventory`, walk forward, then `assert player.speed > 0`.

Several listed 'modified' files do not exist at HEAD:
- game/Debug/UiCommands.cs and UiProbes.cs (P2-10, P2-13 and later) must be created by P2-10, or become [ProbeSource] files after P0-02.
- src/Strata.Core/Gameplay/Town/TownRescue.cs (P5-06) is a new file.
- src/Strata.Core/Content/Index/ does not exist yet.
- game/Testing/Scripts/ui.cmds and perf.cmds are new, and CI runs every Scripts/*.cmds automatically.

P4-01 lists BossInfo.cs as a new file, but BossInfo, BossPart, BossRitual, DayEnrage and KillShield already exist inside EnemyDef.cs (lines 4-157). It is a move, done in P0-01. P2-23 and P3-19 both edit these types, so the move must land first.

ContentValidator.World.cs is 274 lines and about 11 WPs across P1-P4 add rules to it. It will pass 400 lines unless it is split up front (P0-01) and P5-24's ItemSources extraction is pulled forward as P5-24a in W3. Otherwise every new item source (starfall, treasure bags opened via ConsumeParams.Loot, rescues, pets) would be registered in the validator and then moved later. Obtainability warnings do not fail validate (ValidateCommand returns errors only), so gaps would stay silent. Add a Core test that asserts zero obtainability warnings.

WorldLauncher.cs (215 lines) is a wiring hub that about 25 WPs extend, and PlayerController.cs (293) and InteractionController.cs (206) gain 8 to 11 edits each. All three will breach 400 lines unless the P0-01 partial splits land first.

The alias table is global across content categories: ContentDatabase.Current is used for items, prefixes, blocks and every other type. When P3-31 aliases the invented prefix ids to Terraria prefixes, an alias key must not equal an id in any other category, or it would also remap that item or block. Add a validator rule for this, and a PrefixTests fixture that loads an old player save with invented prefixes.

ItemStack is a readonly struct whose equality and CanStackWith compare Item, Count and Prefix. If P2-05 stores favourites on ItemStack, stacking, Transfer and every equality check change behaviour. Store favourites per slot instead (a bool array on Inventory), serialised as SlotModel(..., bool Favorite = false). P2-08's favourite-aware ops read the slot flag.

P2-06 routes coins into coin slots and ammo into ammo slots. The smoke probes `inv.<item>` (for example combat.cmds `assert inv.wooden_arrow == 49`) and the inventory commands must then count the backpack, coin, ammo and trash slots together, or existing smoke scripts fail.

P3-24 moves stone and ore hit counts to Terraria's, and P1-10 changes cooldown semantics. Both change how many `use` calls basic.cmds and builder.cmds need to break a block. Their WPs must update those scripts in the same commit.

P1b-05 adds perf.cmds under game/Testing/Scripts, which CI runs headless on shared runners. Its asserts must use deterministic counters only: main-thread save count, collider rebuilds per edit, tile-object rebuilds per remesh, grass creations per frame, gen2 collections during scripted travel. Wall-clock spike thresholds belong only in the rendering run whose output is attached to the commit.

P1-08 moves the hook state into Core, but the engine's CharacterBody3D owns the player's position during play. The contract must be explicit: Core GrappleHook decides the anchor, state and pull target; PlayerController applies the velocity in _PhysicsProcess; GameWorld.TickPlayer advances the hook only when no engine body is attached (tests and headless runs). Voxel anchors can sit up to about 0.22 m (MaxDrift 0.45 cells) from the smoothed collider, so the release check must test the anchored voxel cell, not a nudged physics point (the current bug at PlayerController.Grapple.cs:106-111).

P1-04's flatter block-light curve (voxel_light.gdshaderinc strata_block_curve) brightens every emitter: lava, glowing ores, mushrooms, shimmer. The radius is still capped by 4-bit propagation at 7.5 m on axes and about 4 m on diagonals. Verify with lighting.cmds stops in a lava cavern, the glowing mushroom biome and the underground desert, not only a torch room. Tune data values (torch [15,13,10]) before raising the shader gain.

P1-03 exposure: Godot 4.7's CameraAttributesPractical auto exposure only adapts within the sensitivity window. With the AgX tonemapper, exposure is multiplied before the glow threshold, so glow also has to be retuned (the level weights currently sum to 4.5). Acceptance must be numeric, not visual. tools/ci/shot_stats.py should assert desert and snow noon mean luminance in [0.35, 0.6] with under 2% clipped pixels, and cave-exit frames at +0.5 s and +2 s, on medium, high and ultra.

P1b-13's threaded asset loading turns first-use creature, prop and animation loads asynchronous. Smoke scripts and tours that check visuals right after `spawn` (creatures.cmds, bosses and animation tours, props.problems) need a `wait_until assets.pending == 0` step or they will race.

P2-12 moves the hotbar to the top-left, where the FPS label (Hud.cs:105) and P1b-05's F3 PerfOverlay sit. P2-09's UiLayout must define a 'debug' region that pushes the overlay below the hotbar and buff rows. UiLayoutTests must include the F3-open case.

P3-43 and P3-44 re-point creature models in data/enemies/evil.json, temple.json and underworld.json, which P4-07, P4-08 and P4-24 also edit in the same wave (W7). Keep one JSON entry per line so text merges succeed, and land P3-44 before P4-08.

Several WPs are sized L and should be split before assignment:
- P5-06: split into P5-06a (Core rescue framework, SiteFinder and data) and P5-06b (per-NPC sites, including the dungeon Mechanic from P4-22).
- P5-15: split into P5-15a (Merchant, Dryad, Arms Dealer, Demolitionist) and P5-15b (Clothier, Goblin, Mechanic, Witch Doctor, plus the Garden partial).

- P3-41: split into P3-41a (pre-hardmode armour sets) and P3-41b (hardmode and lunar sets).
P4-07 (Eater of Worlds segments becoming NPCs and splitting) is also closer to L than M: split it into Core segment life and splitting, then renderer and drops.

P5 plans a new GameWorld.PlayerFiles.cs, but P1b-07 already moves 'the save code' out of GameWorld.cs. Decide once: P1b-07 creates both GameWorld.Saving.cs (async SaveAll and SavePlayer) and GameWorld.PlayerFiles.cs (the static file helpers); P5-25 and P5-26 edit PlayerFiles.cs.

Each of the three animation-set rebuilds (P1-12, P3-03, P5-07) rewrites about 22 MB of binary GLBs, which bloats the pushed branch history. Fold P5-07's rest poses into P3-03 so there are only two rebuilds. Never run two `build_all.py --anims` jobs from different worktrees.

verification_strategy:
Every WP, before merging into the phase branch:
- python3 tools/ci/check_file_length.py
- dotnet build Strata.sln -c Debug
- dotnet test tests/Strata.Core.Tests
- python3 tools/content/gen_ore_tiers.py --check
- Strata.Tools manifest --check, validate and coverage
- python3 tools/content/gen_reference.py --check
- python3 tools/blender/build_all.py --check
- dotnet build Strata.csproj, then godot --headless --import
- every game/Testing/Scripts/*.cmds, run with the CI flags, must print SMOKE PASS
- --menu-tour must print MENU PASS
After P2-02, also run python3 tools/textures/build_ui.py --check. Each wave's push also runs both worktrees' new Core tests together on the merged tree, then the WP-specific checks below.

W0: this is a pure refactor.
- WorldGenTests golden hashes and all smoke logs must be identical to HEAD; check with `git diff --stat`, which should show only moves.
- Keep the P1b-01 worldgen-report as build/wg-before.
- Keep the P1b-05 rendering run of perf.cmds (xvfb, lavapipe, --graphics=medium) as the spike baseline. Lavapipe timings are only compared relative to each other.
- SpikeLogTests pass.

W1a:
- Core tests: TargetingTests, UseTimingTests (mining speed leaves UseAnimation unchanged; one clip per swing), ShotGeometryTests (hand inside a solid falls back to the eye; convergence clamped at 2 m or more), GrappleTests (anchors on natural terrain, platforms and canopies; releases only when the anchored cell breaks), ExposureModelTests and LightingConfigTests.
- Smoke, combat.cmds: starfury and zenith melee; failed uses give feedback with probes msg.last and sfx.last.
- Smoke, basic.cmds: exposure probe at or below the cap.
- Smoke, movement.cmds: hook on a natural slope.
- Lavapipe lighting.cmds on low, medium and high, measured by tools/ci/shot_stats.py:
  - desert and snow noon mean luminance in [0.35, 0.6] with under 2% clipped pixels;
  - cave exit at +0.5 s and +2 s;
  - torch room light still above 0.15 luminance at 5 m;
  - lava cavern not washed out.
- Animation: run build_all.py --anims, then the animation.cmds tour frames at the strike window.

W1b:
- Smoke, combat.cmds: player.facing_error_deg below 3 after `camera orbit 90`; the target behind the player is never selected.

  - Golden hashes re-pinned at GenVersion 10, including at least 3 surface chunks.
  - Outdated-world badge checked in the menu tour.
- worldgen-report --compare against build/wg-before, attached to the commit. Expect lower slope variance and overhang count and no stair-ripple peaks.

- perf.cmds counters show no regression.
